cenas.fala: On Saturday he only qualified sixteenth. On Sunday he started even further back, with twenty cars ahead of him on a soaking wet track.

visual.rodape: Norris wins by 14.6s · Verstappen P2 from P21 · Hadjar P3

cenas.fala: Up front, Lando Norris won from pole, fourteen and a half seconds clear.
But Max gained nineteen places in seventy-one laps.
Car after car after car. Hadjar took third, so two Red Bulls on the podium. And Mercedes? They sealed the constructors' title with fourth and fifth.
Comeback of the year? Drop a yes or a no in the comments, and follow for tomorrow's story.

legenda_post: 21st to 2nd in the Interlagos rain 🌧️ Verstappen gained 19 places, Norris won from pole and Mercedes sealed the constructors' title. Comeback of the year? Yes or no 👇
